explication: FinRobot is a financial decision-intelligence platform with three generations: the production V2 desktop research system, a V1 web report generator, and an educational V0 AutoGen framework. The main V2 workflow takes a ticker or research request through data retrieval, agent-led analysis and deterministic valuation, then presents traceable research artifacts and reports. Coverage management, chat, audit/provenance, and backtesting are related capabilities. The graph emphasizes V2; older-generation connections are limited to README descriptions because their full runtime wiring was not sampled.
